goal: Speed up scriptpubkeyman fuzz testing and prevent premature test termination
Allows developers and fuzzing infrastructure to explore deeper execution paths much faster
agreement: Strong support with all concerns regarding test assertions resolved
Verified benchmark speedup from roughly 40 exec/s to up to 385 exec/s (andrewtoth)
Concept approval praising the bug fix and moving heavy work out of hot paths (pablomartin4btc)
Concerns about weakened invariant assertions were resolved by restoring checks (maflcko, pablomartin4btc)
